name: ToneDot
description: A tone-keyed state marker without an application-specific status vocabulary.
signature: ({ tone, marker, label, overlay, className, ...rest }: ToneDotProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible state name; omit only beside a visible equivalent label.

props.name: marker
props.description: A solid dot, hollow ring, or compositor-only live pulse.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Solid corner mark with a separating surface ring.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic state, or data for informational activity such as a running timer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
